description: This file contains functions for exporting notes in various formats (PDF, Markdown, Text, HTML) within the Notesnook project. It includes functions for exporting individual notes and multiple notes, handling streams, creating ZIP files, and interacting with the DOM for PDF printing.

classes.name: ExportStream
classes.description: Custom stream class used for exporting notes, providing progress tracking and report integration.

methods.name: exportToPDF
methods.description: Exports a note content as a PDF by creating an iframe, setting its content, and invoking the print dialog.

methods.name: exportNotes
methods.description: Exports multiple notes in specified formats, creating a ZIP archive and handling errors.

methods.name: exportNote
methods.description: Exports a single note in specified format, handling attachments and PDF export.
